title: INCOLOR SPEEDSTER SR / SR+ product document
notes: Official exact-model document states 46 mm internal frame/fork width and a drivetrain-dependent maximum: 38C slick or 36C small-knob tires with 1×, but 32C slick tires with 2×. It records T47A, UDH, the included cockpit and seatpost, SR M60 + T800 construction at 785 g and CNY 12,800, and SR+ 80T pitch-based + T1100 construction at 720 g and CNY 18,800. Both weights are size 54, unpainted and exclude metal hardware.
